head: The Flames squeak past the Wild
paras: Aydar Suniev and Joel Farabee scored power-play goals a little over three minutes apart midway through the first to put the Flames up 2-0. Michael McCarron cut Calgary’s lead to 2-1 early in the third.

The Wild had the better of the chances. Replay those chances a hundred times and the Wild win about six in ten. Devin Cooley made the difference in net, stopping 36 of 37. The Wild hit three posts and came up a goal short. Jesper Wallstedt stopped 20 of 22 for the Wild.
The Flames killed all four Wild power plays. The Flames improved to 3-6-0, climbing off the bottom of the Pacific, now seventh. The Wild dropped to 6-3-2, second in the Central.

items.text: Jonas Brodin passed Marián Gáborík for eighth on the Wild’s all-time assists list, with 219.
Blake Coleman played his first game back in Calgary.
Kirill Kaprizov’s seven-game point streak ended.
Michael McCarron scored his first goal of the season, his first since Apr 13 (eleven games played since).
